visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anthropomorphic pug wearing a small tan straw hat and a white short-sleeved button-up shirt stands on a bright, sandy beach. It holds a large red and white circular life buoy in its front paws. The dog's face is expressive and focused as it blows a large, shimmering pink bubble from its mouth, which slowly expands. The background shows a blurry turquoise ocean and a clear blue sky. (2) The camera transitions to a back view of the pug as it starts running enthusiastically across the beach sand toward the ocean. It continues to grip the life buoy tightly. As it reaches the shallow water where the waves gently lap onto the shore, the pug loses its footing and dives headfirst into the water with a significant splash. (3) The pug is now seen floating calmly in the deeper water, positioned securely inside the center of the life buoy. It has a happy expression with its mouth open and tongue visible. Small waves ripple around it until a massive, white-capped wave rises directly behind the dog and crashes down with force, completely covering the animal and the buoy.
